company.name: Smallstep
company.shortDescription: Smallstep is an open-source toolkit to automate certificate administration and secure infrastructures.
company.description: Smallstep develops an identity authority for dev/sec/ops teams that integrate with delivery pipelines, making code identity-aware to secure connected apps across clouds, containers, serverless, and devices. By converting security best practices into an open-source toolkit, it’s designed to allow developers or operators to safeguard their infrastructure.

productsAndServices.description: A platform that provides hardware-bound device identity to ensure only company-owned devices can access sensitive enterprise resources.
productsAndServices.name: Device Identity Platform™

productsAndServices.description: An open standard co-developed by Smallstep and Google for high-assurance device identity using hardware co-processors for attestation and keybinding.
productsAndServices.name: ACME Device Attestation (ACME DA)

productsAndServices.description: A hosted private certificate authority service that automates certificate lifecycle management for internal workloads and developers.
productsAndServices.name: Certificate Manager

productsAndServices.description: An open-source command-line tool for managing certificates, cryptographic operations, and identity tokens across multiple operating systems.

productsAndServices.description: A commercial private certificate authority solution that extends the open-source step-ca with advanced features and compliance options.
productsAndServices.name: Step CA Pro
